title: Sleepy Bridgeman
body:
Description

Sleepy Bridgeman is removed in version 1.45.6 and got returned to a new place in version 1.51.0

Sleepy Bridgeman, the second operator of the bridge from Ferwater Island to Finlay Island. He is very tired and needs your help putting down the bridge.

As of version 1.71.0, the Sleepy Bridgeman controls the Snowdrift Station A in the Snowlands biome and is now called the Sleepy Cablecar Operator.
